name: Critical Antipodal Pairs Give Contraction Obstructions
statement: If a learning-space base has a complementary pair whose two endpoints are invalid roots, while after every coordinate deletion at least one projected endpoint becomes valid, then its pendant-antipode extension is a contraction-minimal nonlearning partial cube.
proof: The pendant extension is nonlearning by the endpoint criterion. Contracting the pendant coordinate recovers the learning base. Every other contraction commutes with the construction and has a valid projected endpoint, so it is learning.
